subject: Buying the dip, REIT income, and the AI buildout
body_text:
96 
 Your September podcast roundup is here–listen now. September Podcast Roundup 

   

 
 This month’s Investing Experts Podcast episodes explore market momentum, cannabis investing, REIT income, and opportunities emerging from the AI infrastructure buildout. Listen in for timely ideas and analysis on some of the biggest themes shaping markets today. 

 
   Momentum, Fear & The Case For Buying The Dip
 

 
 Guest: Steven Cress, VP of Quantitative Strategy at Seeking Alpha
 

 
 What does history suggest after a sharp market correction? Steven Cress examines past momentum reversals and explains why fundamentally strong stocks can present opportunities when fear drives a pullback.
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Listen Now 
   ‘Let’s Go All In On Cannabis’—Grown Rogue’s Obie Strickler & Josh Rosen
 

 
 Guests: Obie Strickler, CEO & Founder of Grown Rogue; Josh Rosen, Chief Strategy Officer 
 

 
 Obie Strickler and Josh Rosen discuss Grown Rogue’s expansion into New York and the regulatory uncertainty still shaping cannabis valuations. Hear why they’re focused on state-level performance, disciplined growth, and building a sustainable cannabis business.
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Listen Now 
   Look At REITs As Dividend Income Machines
 

 
 Guest: David Auerbach, Chief Investment Officer of Hoya Capital 
 

 
 David Auerbach makes the case for looking at REITs as income generators after years of elevated interest rates. Find out why he sees value in small- and mid-cap REITs and what makes them particularly interesting for income-focused investors.
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Listen Now 
   Beyond Nvidia: Finding Opportunity In The AI Buildout
 

 
 Guest: Joe Albano, Investing Group Leader of Tech Cache 
 

 
 AI infrastructure spending is surging, but so are the costs for the companies driving the buildout. Joe Albano looks beyond the most prominent AI names to less crowded beneficiaries, including Bloom Energy and the growing demand for power solutions for data centers.
